column1: # CADCraft Hebrew interface catalog — original translations (AI-assisted) for Natan Auerbach.
# License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the repository LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE).
# Written from CADCraft's English strings; no proprietary translations were copied.
# UTF-8: context<TAB>English source<TAB>Hebrew translation, in logical (typing) order.
# The app reorders it for display because egui has no bidi pass (see docs/localization.md).
# Empty context = ordinary label; @plural = one|other forms with {n}.
# Keep command IDs, keywords, technology/product names and user data unchanged.
